name: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Atlas — Internal Data Manifest
purpose: Machine-readable map of substantive backend layers. Public navigation is owned by manifest.json and the unified Potato of Life site; this file registers internal data contracts without creating a competing public reader.
public_navigation: manifest.json → POTATO OF LIFE → current branches / pathways / context clusters
navigation_rule: Do not maintain parallel public readers for the same corpus. Static crawlable pages and the interactive reader are two representations of the same canonical graph.
architecture_rule: One body of knowledge, many substantive data structures, one Potato of Life public root. Canonical records own definitions; evidence, chronology, research and relationships add context without becoming duplicate identities.
information_principle: Maximize useful information per surviving artifact. Prefer a thick canonical record or genuinely reusable dataset over shallow wrappers, generated snapshots or obsolete presentation files.
consolidation_rule: One concept has one canonical identity and definition owner. Other appearances are evidence, occurrence, research, relationship, chronology, projection or creative artifact.
fallback: Local repository data remains available when optional live enrichment fails.
anti_clutter_rule: A file earns existence only when it owns distinct valuable information, primary-source material, a reusable schema, a necessary index, a contextual synthesis or a real executable function. Placeholder scaffolds, generated snapshots, stale route maps and duplicate wrappers are removed or archived after consolidation.

terrain_and_formalism.public_note: These are data/framework layers surfaced through current records and context, not standalone public root pages.

retired_public_contracts: AXIS / WORLD as the only public root
migration_rule: Retired presentation artifacts may remain temporarily for provenance or migration, but validators and new code must not require them as current public architecture.
